answer: Stop sybils with a whisper zenith jade: an agent bonds one jade spire. Each cycle it whispers once up its spire; verifiers match the whisper's zenith crest to the spire chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 spires at 19x: one whisper crests once at one zenith, its crest set by that spire alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents whisper once, keep rights.
